Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D metroidvania environment art, a modular NEAR BACKGROUND prop atlas, not a repeating wall tile, not a gameplay level screenshot. Output one 2048x2048 PNG with genuine transparent alpha outside objects. Exactly FOUR isolated prop assemblies in a precise 2x2 grid, each assembly fully inside its own 1024x1024 quadrant with 70px empty transparent margins; nothing crosses the central gutters. No labels, text, frames, checkerboard drawing or ground plane. Each assembly must be a different organic asymmetrical silhouette with large negative spaces, slightly worn soft edges, chunky broad painted texture, restrained hand-painted material facets. Premium illustrated dark fantasy, neither photorealistic nor vector nor pixel art. Match the craftsmanship and broad material texture of the reference playable terrain, but simplify finest detail by 30%. Mid-dark material values, soft diffuse light, no white highlights, no glow. Background props need recognizable silhouette at gameplay scale. No characters, enemies, collectible objects, UI, spikes, thin scratchy microtexture. Do NOT copy the uniformly repeated wall pattern in the screenshot. Each assembly has depth and overlap but straight-on sideview, no strong perspective.
Warm muted taupe and parchment-gray underground paper fissures. TOP LEFT: massive folded torn page arch, one side collapsed, open asymmetrical hollow. TOP RIGHT: tall curling layered paper buttress with a few dangling broad paper strips. BOTTOM LEFT: low mound of piled unprinted books and broad page curls, horizontal silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT: an old skewed bookcase half embedded in paper earth, a short branch-like fold above it. All paper is gray-brown aged and dim, NOT bright ivory. No legible writing.
